blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa’s wife, Nancy dela Rosa, has pleaded to the “powerful few” not to use her husband for their personal agenda, stressing the senator needs help, not persecution. She also thanked dela Rosa’s supporters saying they have helped her realize “that there are millions who still believe and support” them. READ: Lacson: Bato dela Rosa safer in PH than abroad amid ICC warrant “I just pray that the powerful few who were also his friends would come to realize he is not their enemy nor the enemy of this state.
